name: Akanthosuchus
isnote: An alligatoroid regarded as a possible alligatorine; its position inside Alligatoroidea has not been settled.
sum: Paleocene alligatoroid from New Mexico with unusual spiked and blade-shaped armour plates.
wsnote: Moderately sized; the femur of the holotype is 137 mm long, but the specimen may not have been fully grown.
holotype: NMMNH NP-139 — partial skeleton without the skull, Nacimiento Formation, San Juan Basin, New Mexico.
material: Holotype with the hindlimbs, 28 vertebrae and about 200 osteoderms, plus isolated osteoderms.
biology: Its armour mixed square, oval, bladed and conical spiked osteoderms; the spikes may have run in paired rows down the back and tail and along the flanks.
author: O'Neill et al. 1981
